# Cncf Omni Reviewer

Review Omni using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. Omni is a Kubernetes orchestrator for bare metal and edge environments. It manages full OS and Kubernetes lifecycles with Talos Linux and remote management with wireguard communication.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
